## SEARCH-2 — Live search, filters, and results panel

Implemented the read-only, in-memory search path for one open case, including the 150 ms debounce, type/tag filters, live result announcements, keyboard result navigation, board centering, and card-list wiring.

### Files created

- `src/features/search/searchCards.ts`
- `src/features/search/SearchPanel.tsx`
- `src/features/search/SearchPanel.css`
- `tests/search/searchCards.test.ts`
- `tests/search/SearchPanel.test.tsx`

### Files changed

- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.tsx`
- `src/features/case/CaseBoardPage.css`
- `src/features/case/CardListPanel.tsx`
- `src/features/case/CardListPanel.css`

### Acceptance evidence

| Criterion | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Title, tag, and OCR matches; missing OCR does not throw | Pass | `searchCards.test.ts` covers each field, missing/blank OCR, and non-searchable metadata |
| 150 ms query debounce; filters apply immediately | Pass | Fake-timer tests assert 149 ms/1 ms boundary; filter clicks update results immediately |
| Type AND tag AND query; OR within selected tags; Clear all resets everything | Pass | Combination and Clear-all component tests |
| Result count and no-result explanation announced | Pass | Single mounted `role="status"` with `aria-live="polite"` and `aria-atomic="true"` |
| Selecting centers and selects on the board; Open detail navigates without writes | Pass | Board store viewport/selection asserted; repository card and case unchanged; detail link test |
| Search/filter calls perform no writes | Pass | Frozen-data/purity tests plus unchanged repository assertions |

### Keyboard and viewport exercised

- Keyboard: searchbox → type → `ArrowDown` enters results → `ArrowUp`/`ArrowDown`/`Home`/`End` move → `Enter` selects; Filters, Clear all, active-filter removals, and Open detail are native controls.
- Component tests run in jsdom. No Playwright viewport matrix was added, per the task’s explicit exclusion; SEARCH-3/QA owns browser evidence.
- Phone CSS breakpoint at 37.5 rem provides a full-width, full-height in-flow sheet; no horizontal overflow mechanisms were introduced.

### Accessibility evidence

- 44×44 CSS assertions for result buttons, detail links, filter chips, and active-filter removals.
- Token-driven `:focus-visible` outlines on search input, chips, result buttons, detail links, and removals.
- Result count/no-result region is always mounted before results and never steals focus.
- Clear all returns focus to the search field; board selection moves focus to the board heading.
- Contrast assertions cover ink, muted ink, headings, links, error text, and selected-chip text at ≥ 4.5:1.
- No raw palette literals in the new/changed stylesheets; no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`; a card title containing a `<script>` string renders as text.

### Shared-file handoff

- `CaseBoardPage.tsx` now accepts `?card=<id>` for card-list search selection. Preserve the order: load cards → reset board viewport → apply centered temporary viewport and selection once. It uses `applyTemporaryViewport`, so search navigation is not persisted as a camera move.
- `CardListPanel.tsx` embeds `SearchPanel`, hides grouped rows while search criteria are active, and defaults result selection to `/case/:caseId?card=:cardId`. Preserve the `onSearchSelect` override for other surfaces.
- `CaseBoardPage.css` and `CardListPanel.css` contain only token-driven additions.

### Validation

- `npm test -- tests/search/searchCards.test.ts tests/search/SearchPanel.test.tsx` — **26 passed**
- `npm run typecheck` — **exit 0**
- Full suite: `npm test -- --reporter=dot` — **726 passed, 53 files**
- `npm run lint` — **exit 0**
- Prettier check — **all matched files formatted**
- `npm run build` — **exit 0**

Non-blocking limitation: browser viewport behavior at phone/tablet sizes is not exercised in this task; that remains SEARCH-3/QA scope.

handoff.summary: Implemented SEARCH-2: pure in-memory search selector, debounced search panel with type/tag filters, keyboard result list, live count/no-result announcements, board centering/selection, Open detail navigation, and card-list wiring. Targeted tests, full suite, typecheck, lint, formatting, and build pass.
decisions: Tag filters are ORed; type, tag, and text criteria are ANDed.
Search selection uses a temporary board viewport so it centers without overwriting the stored camera.
Card-list selection navigates to the board with ?card=<id> so Select means center-and-select on both surfaces; Open detail remains the detail route.
The phone presentation is a full-width, full-height in-flow sheet, intentionally not a focus-trapping modal.
interfaces: searchCards(cards, { query?, type?, tags? }) -> readonly CardSearchResult[] with titleMatched, matchedTags, ocrSnippet
SearchPanel({ cards, onSelectCard, detailHref?, id?, title?, defaultFiltersOpen?, debounceMs?, onActiveChange?, className? })
CardListPanel gained optional onSearchSelect and searchDetailHref
CaseBoardPage accepts ?card=<id> to center and select a card
warnings: No browser viewport matrix was run for SEARCH-2 because the task excludes it; phone/tablet CSS behavior is covered by the stylesheet contract only.
Tablet uses the same inline panel rather than a distinct right-side overlay; functional use is covered, visual presentation is left for the style gate.
